name: Gaussian hill, terrain-tangent prescribed wind, passive 3D puff
equation: dC/dt+div(u C)=0; no diffusion, deposition, chemistry or later emissions
exact_solution: C(x,y,z,t)=F(x-5*t,y,z-h(x,y)); Jacobian d(x,y,eta)/d(x,y,z)=1; eta=z-h is invariant
initial_quadrature: one scrambled 3D Sobol set, seed42, transformed by Gaussian inverse CDF; same positions/weights required in both particle methods
geometry_information: Prescribed analytical terrain and wind, not WRF-generated wind or real geographic data.
scope: 3D pure-advection/terrain-coupling verification. Not diffusion, turbulent mountain wind generation, or real forecast validation.

native_admission.FLEXPART: must read shared initial particles via supported initial-particle interface, turbulence disabled; pending
native_admission.MPTRAC: native module_advect with supplied gridded physical wind/omega, diffusion omitted; pending
native_admission.CALPUFF: native terrain coupling candidate MCTADJ3 PPC1; Gaussian initial-state and zero-spreading interfaces must pass before any three-way concentration score
